market_definition.segment: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region who work with several clients at once

claims.claim: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region struggle to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
claims.quote: most of my clients couldn't distinguish a good design from a better one! I interviewed my clients, and 90% of them told me the only way they could identify a designer professional or not wasn't by their work but by their project management and communication abilities.
